change_summary: Separate read-only NFL/NBA/CFB/CBB player-prop pair benchmark. Exact PIT event/leg identity, source and final clocks, documented unverified SHA evidence, no missing outcome/prop lines, paired joint/independence Brier and event-level descriptive intervals; synthetic CI; frozen v5 and stakes unchanged.
assumptions: Only complete separately witnessed original pregame leg forecasts and full settled final outcomes should be ingested; missing data fails closed, never guessed.
Upstream timestamps, alleged source name and correctly-shaped digests are NOT independently authenticated provider source delivery or original book offers.
Joint probability is an optional frozen forecast; no existing real matched corpus or prospective fitted correlation is claimed.
Same two player/market/line/period/settlement identities are required for every observation; arbitrary correlations and mixed events cannot be pooled.
Confidence intervals with fewer than 30 independently counted game events are withheld; all intervals descriptive only.
